description: Capture a screenshot of a web page, inline HTML, or a saved PolyDoc template. Provide exactly one source: url, html, or templateId. Returns PNG/JPEG/WebP written to the configured output directory, plus an inline image preview when small enough to display.

advanced.description: Raw fields deep-merged into the request body for any API option not exposed here (e.g. pdf.watermark, render, request).

delivery.description: download writes the file locally; cloudStorage uploads to a presigned URL; webhook posts the file to a URL.

filename.description: Output filename. Written under the configured output directory (basename only).

html.description: Inline HTML to render. Provide exactly one of url, html, or templateId.

presignedUrl.description: Presigned PUT URL, required when delivery is cloudStorage.

returnBase64.description: Also return the file as base64 in structured output (heavy; for clients without a filesystem).

sandbox.description: Override the server default for this call. Sandbox output is watermarked and rate-limited (about 5 requests/sec).

tag.description: Label for logging and analytics (max 30 chars).

templateData.description: Variables for the Liquid template (used with templateId).

templateId.description: ID of a saved PolyDoc template. Provide exactly one of url, html, or templateId.

url.description: Public URL to render. Provide exactly one of url, html, or templateId.

webhook.description: Webhook config, required when delivery is webhook. Shape: { url, async?, method?, headers?, retries? }.

name: polydoc_screenshot

filePath.description: Absolute path of the written file (download).

title: PolyDoc: Capture Screenshot
